title: Pinaka UQS Profile — CA Foundation Quantitative Aptitude (v1)
description: TIER: PROFILE. Specializes uqs-core-1 for CA Foundation Paper 3 (Quantitative Aptitude). It composes the Core via allOf + $ref and narrows it for this exam only: exam is ca_foundation, id namespace is caf_(qa|be), difficulty scale is L1-L3, single_best carries exactly 4 options, and item-level assets (diagrams/images) are disabled for v1. Everything not narrowed here is inherited unchanged from the Core. To add another exam, write a sibling profile against the same Core; do not edit the Core.

id.description: CA Foundation Paper 3 (Quantitative Aptitude) items only. The caf_be subject code (Paper 4 Business Economics) belongs to a separate future profile.

ext_ca.description: CA Foundation QA extension fields. additionalProperties:false enforces the closed set — typos are rejected rather than silently accepted.
